PAT-1.title: Read Context First
PAT-1.statement: Before interpreting a chart, identify its title, horizontal and vertical axes, units, time span, and visible scale.

PAT-2.title: Trend
PAT-2.statement: A trend is a sustained change in one direction across multiple observations.

PAT-3.title: Anomaly
PAT-3.statement: An anomaly is an observation or compact cluster that differs materially from the surrounding pattern.

PAT-4.title: Insufficient Evidence
PAT-4.statement: When there are too few observations or essential labels are missing, classify the evidence as insufficient rather than forcing a trend or anomaly conclusion.

PAT-5.title: Evidence-Based Classification
PAT-5.statement: A defensible classification names both the category and visible evidence.

PAT-6.title: Timing Is Not Causation
PAT-6.statement: Temporal proximity alone does not establish that one event caused the other.
